answer: Map every agent's attestation edges into a trust graph and run community detection: identities whose links fold back on each other form a dense kin-cluster, and the protocol caps that whole cluster's voting weight at one honest node's worth. A Sybil swarm reads as a garden of clones attesting each other, so it nets nothing. To earn real influence each fake must grow its own jetty out into the honest core, winning costly independent attestations from long-rooted cedar nodes no attacker controls. Forging 1,000 such cross-cluster edges means 1,000 separate real reputations, not one shared fake.
